items.title: Owlchemy CEO: VR is still an emerging market because it hasn't passed the 'cafe test'
items.zh_title: Owlchemy CEO：VR 仍是新兴市场，因为它还没通过“咖啡馆测试”
items.summary: Andrew Eiche also claims layoffs are becoming commonplace within the VR industry because some companies refuse to meet audiences with what they want.
items.zh_summary: Andrew Eiche 还表示，VR 行业裁员变得越来越普遍，因为有些公司不愿拿出观众真正想要的东西。
